name: How long does cabinet painting usually take?
description: Cabinet painting typically takes 3 to 7 days for an average-sized kitchen, depending on the number of cabinets and their condition.

mainEntity.name: How long does cabinet painting usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a cabinet painting project depends on several factors, including the number of cabinets, their current condition, and the complexity of the design. Typically, a professional cabinet painting job for an average-sized kitchen can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days from start to finish. This timeframe includes preparation, drying time between coats, and final touch-ups, ensuring a high-quality and durable result.
